name: manual_2e9ff8
claim: Judge a file transfer lane by delivery, not acceptance: count ok plus received_at plus a byte count equal to the file size. A bare drop defaulted to the plain portal port and queued a stale record while the pinned-TLS lane delivered every file; four portal accepts versus zero of two gossip posts on the same day.

decisions.notes: Direct evidence from the 2026-11-10 cline session: the mesh emit reported zero of two peers delivered while four portal sends were accepted; the wrong-port default was later fixed in orama PR 491.

rationale: Direct evidence from the 2026-11-10 cline session: the mesh emit reported zero of two peers delivered while four portal sends were accepted; the wrong-port default was later fixed in orama PR 491.
